note: The live MCP tools/list response is authoritative. All tools are read-only. Scripture tools default to api_version v3; select v2 explicitly for upstream v2. Generic tools require service and api_version. Preserve native upstream data, source freshness and rights metadata.

tools.name: list_translations
tools.purpose: Discover a version's translations and rich metadata, including copyright.

tools.name: list_books
tools.purpose: Discover book names, numbers and available scope in a translation.

tools.name: list_chapters
tools.purpose: Discover chapters and their hashes in a translated book.

tools.name: get_scripture
tools.purpose: Read a whole translation, book or chapter with before/after scope SHA-1 consistency checks.

tools.name: query_verses
tools.purpose: Resolve selected or grouped references, preserving native data without a chapter-hash envelope.

tools.name: search_verses
tools.purpose: Search with matching modes, book/scope filters, exclusions, proximity, sorting and pagination.

tools.name: search_dictionary_entries
tools.purpose: Find a bounded page of exact entry IDs by dictionary key, alias or index search text, preserving original records and freshness.

tools.name: get_hash
tools.purpose: Read a static scripture translation, book or chapter SHA-1.

tools.name: get_hash_manifest
tools.purpose: Read bulk scripture checksums for cache synchronization.

tools.name: check_for_updates
tools.purpose: Compare stored hashes and identify invalidation actions without extending expired data.

tools.name: discover_apis
tools.purpose: Discover all services, versions and authoritative OpenAPI URLs.

tools.name: describe_api_operation
tools.purpose: List a contract's operations or describe one with exact input and response schemas.

tools.name: call_api_operation
tools.purpose: Execute any documented read-only operation, including text/checksum routes and search POST.
